# Gospel of Thomas, Saying 98 — The LOGOS Bible (Formal Equivalence)

**Source:** Nag Hammadi Codex II, p. 51 | Coptic

---

## Saying 98

Jesus said: "The kingdom of the Father is like a man who wanted to kill a strong man. He drew his sword in his own house and thrust it into the wall to test whether his hand would be strong enough. Then he went and killed the strong man."

---

**Translator's Notes (LOGOS):**

- "Wanted to kill" — the intention is foregrounded
- "To test whether his hand would be strong enough" — the purpose of the wall-stabbing made explicit
- "Went and killed" — the decisive action as the culmination
